latency.note: Profile pass uses max_tokens=1; latency is prefill-dominant and includes one decode token.

timing.note: Request metrics from vLLM. With max_tokens=1, scheduled_to_first_token_s is the closest available prefill proxy; decode_s should be near zero and E2E includes queue/scheduling.

straggler.note: Batch-layer rank max/mean imbalance computed from routed_experts and the active layer-wise expert->rank map.

load_profile.note: Expert load is determined by router choice and is placement-invariant; rank load applies the active layer-wise expert->rank map.
